name: galley-js
description: npm workspace root for the npm-built Galley adapters: one install links core, node, bun, and wasm, built core-first by dependency order. The deno adapter is source-only and the universal package installs standalone, so neither is a member (workspace membership flips Deno into npm-linking mode).

scripts.build: npm run build -w galley-js-core && npm run build -w galley-js-node -w galley-js-bun -w galley-js-wasm
